title: Building a 30+ Meetings-per-Month Pipeline for a B2B Founder
challenge: A B2B services founder relied on referrals, networking and occasional LinkedIn posts to acquire clients. Business development was inconsistent and difficult to forecast.
solution: Myntmore rebuilt the founder's LinkedIn positioning, developed a practical thought leadership strategy and launched a targeted outbound system. Messaging was designed around specific industry problems and buying triggers.
results: A more structured and repeatable lead generation process.
